endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup
endpoints.description: Deep immune check for one Arc token: four readings in one call, fused into one grade. EXIT: a real buy-then-sell round trip simulated on Arc (nothing spent), the pool fee, a dynamic-fee hook, and whether a plain wallet can pull the liquidity. endpoints.name: England Works Watch
endpoints.description: UK Skilled Worker sponsor-compliance change intelligence for employer, HR and HRIS agents. Use for official GOV.UK source freshness, Home Office/UKVI sponsor reporting, supported sponsor change categories, and one-event or batch impact preflight. Supported vocabulary includes absence, salary, role or occupation-code change, work-location or home-working change, delayed starts, stopping sponsorship or worker departure, organisation changes, TUPE transfers, and mergers/takeovers. The public AI edition supports an interactive single-event preflight. Commercial value is concentrated in metered programmatic execution, 1-25 event batch assessment, and the separate 30-day official-source monitoring report. Deterministic decisions return AFFECTED, NOT_AFFECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED or INSUFFICIENT_INPUT with evidence and fail closed on stale/changed sources. Not individual visa advice or a Home Office decision. The two paid HTTP compatibility routes execute the same deterministic decision engine as the MCP tools.

endpoints.name: FiatDock
endpoints.description: A marketplace where AI agents discover and pay each other per call in USDC over x402 — settlement goes DIRECTLY to the seller, non-custodial, no accounts and no API keys. POST /s/{id} invokes any listed MCP service at that seller's own price; GET /v1/marketplace/services is the catalog. Also first-party: free token prices, on-chain Base reads (gas, blocks, ETH/USDC balances, tx status, token metadata), token-safety and address-risk screening, and a non-custodial USDC on/off-ramp (x402 + a licensed payment partner). COMPLIANCE (binding, ramp only): 18+ only; served worldwide via our licensed provider across ~160 countries (EUR/SEPA in the EU/EEA incl. Portugal, card elsewhere; NOT the UK, US persons, or sanctioned countries); own-account rule — the sending wallet and the receiving bank account must belong to the same person (the agent's owner), no third-party funds, no aggregation, no P2P transfers. Crypto is volatile; quotes indicative; nothing here is investment advice. RETRIES: GET endpoints are idempotent — repeat freely. Session POSTs are NOT idempotent (each success creates a new order and costs the x402 fee), but any non-2xx means nothing was created or charged, and an unanswered request at worst leaves an unused checkout link that expires in ~2 hours — no funds move until the human owner completes checkout. Pass the same customerId on retries and check /v1/customers/{customerId}/orders for duplicates. On 429, sleep Retry-After seconds.

endpoints.description:

Astro, Drupal, Joomla, Laravel, Django, etc.) por firmas en headers y HTML.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Captura un screenshot PNG de una página real, vía un navegador headless
(Chromium sobre protocolo CDP). Espera ~2s tras navegar antes de capturar.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Exporta una página real a PDF (con fondos), vía navegador headless (CDP `Page.printToPDF`).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Extrae metadata HTML (title, meta description, canonical, favicon, Open Graph) de una página.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Extrae el contenido principal de un artículo/página (algoritmo Readability) y lo convierte a Markdown.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Extrae hasta 30 links `<a href>` de una página y revisa cuáles responden con error (HEAD request a cada uno).
Solo devuelve los links rotos, no la lista completa de links encontrados.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Consulta WHOIS de un dominio. Devuelve la salida cruda del registro, sin parsear.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Traceroute real (máx. 20 saltos, 2s de espera por salto, 20s total).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Obtiene subject/issuer/fechas de validez del certificado TLS de un host, vía openssl.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Sigue la cadena de redirects HTTP de una URL (máx. 15 saltos), sin
seguirlos automáticamente — cada salto se reporta con su status.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Escanea puertos TCP de un host (conexión directa, 3s de timeout por puerto, en paralelo).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Envía 4 pings ICMP a un host y devuelve si respondió más la salida cruda.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Audita 6 headers de seguridad comunes (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options,
X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) en una URL.

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Busca registros SPF y DMARC de un dominio por TXT lookup. No incluye DKIM
(su selector es específico de cada proveedor de correo, no tiene ubicación fija).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Detecta CDN/WAF (Cloudflare, Akamai, CloudFront, Fastly, Vercel, Sucuri, Imperva,
nginx/OpenResty, Varnish) a partir de headers HTTP (HEAD, con fallback a GET).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description:
Resuelve un registro DNS para un host, vía `dig`. Rechaza hosts con
caracteres fuera de [a-zA-Z0-9.-] (protección contra inyección de flags).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Consulta si una IPv4 está en la blacklist de Spamhaus ZEN (DNSBL).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call
endpoints.description: Resuelve el ASN, prefijo, país y nombre de la organización dueña de una IP/host, vía Team Cymru (whois-over-DNS).

endpoints.name: GeekVault — API catalog for AI agents, paid per call

Coverage 2024-2026.

Coverage 2024-2026.

endpoints.name: Marshall x402
endpoints.description: Turkey business-day count between two dates (inclusive): official holidays, half days (religious holiday eves and 28 Oct from 13:00 = 0.5) and public-sector administrative leave. Coverage 2024-2026.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index

endpoints.description: Serialise a JSON value without insignificant whitespace.

endpoints.description: Read an RFC 6901 pointer from a JSON value without executing expressions.

endpoints.description: Pretty-print a JSON value with two-space indentation.

endpoints.description: Validate JSON syntax only, not a user-provided schema.

The agreement is paid once and recorded as a grant (taifoon.access.grant.v1); your key’s policy then carries the access id in `entitlements`, the stream and /v1/pipe/status show you the sealed ciphertext instead of the elision, and the seller seals each epoch’s key to the recipient key you published at POST /v1/pipe/keys. Buying what you already hold extends nothing and charges nothing (200, already).

endpoints.description: FREE, verify-only rehearsal of the two-leg x402 payment (main leg + platform-fee leg) on this deployment's networks (testnet on preview, mainnet on production). endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Convert a duration between units and get it in plain language. Use it to express a timeout in the unit the caller asked for, or to check whether a limit is seconds, minutes or milliseconds.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Count the business days between two dates, excluding weekends. Use it to turn a calendar deadline into a working-day deadline. Public holidays are not excluded, so the count is an upper bound.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Convert between a date and a Unix timestamp, in either direction. Use it when a payload carries one and the other is needed.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Add a duration to an instant and get the result, in UTC and in Tehran local time. Use it for a TTL, a lock expiry, or a token lifetime.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Which day of the week a date falls on, and whether it is a business day. Use it before scheduling work or setting a deadline that lands on a weekend.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Decide how a client should react to a status code: retry with backoff, check the outcome before retrying, or do not retry. Includes a suggested backoff schedule.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Look up an HTTP status code: what it means, what the client must do, whether it is retryable, whether it is safe to replay, the defining RFC and the common causes.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Look up a MIME type by full type or by file extension: the top-level type, what it is for, and the usual file extension.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Describe an HTTP method: whether it is safe, whether it is idempotent, whether it carries a body, and what it is for.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Describe an instant: its date, weekday and time in UTC and in Tehran local time (UTC+03:30), plus the Unix timestamp. Use it when a response carries a timestamp and the local date matters.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: List or search MIME types by top-level type or by keyword, for example image types or anything to do with calendars.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: How much time is between two instants: the direction, the total in every unit, and a day/hour/minute/second breakdown. Use it to compute a retry delay, a rate-limit reset, or whether a deadline has passed.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Find the HTTP status code that matches a described situation, when the code is not known in advance — for example 'the caller is being rate limited' or 'upstream returned garbage'.

endpoints.name: WebRef
endpoints.description: Check whether a Content-Type header matches what an endpoint kind expects, and say what to send instead when it does not.
